x: Gordon Biscoe, Road Running Secretary, seems to be forsaking his old haunt the 'Duke's' on Tuesday evenings. Is it the lure of Belgrave Hall or Chris Barber & Co at "The George".
C.Barber · Running · Alan R. Lucas · Walking

400m: P.Gee 53.1, P.Williamson 56.4; 800m: C.Barber (MAC/2nd claim Bel) 1:54.3, D.Wiseman 2:03.1, A.Mead 2:04.2; 10000m Southern Champ.: D.Maughan 34:22, LJ: R.Hopkins 6.46m, S.Crosbie 6.24m, R.McCrossen 6.16m.
We also had an interest in the 1mile where Chris Barber, one of our 2nd-claim members qualified for the final with 4:05.5, beating the eventual winner Dave Black in the process.
Another to find foreign athletes ahead of him was our second-claimer Chris Barber. In his heat of the 1,500 metres he crossed the line 6th in 3:46.9 behind four overseas competitors.
Amongst our second claimers some good times last season came from Keith May (400m/51.7, 800m/1:56.1, 1,500m/4:00.3) and Chris Barber (800m/1:52.0, 1 mile/4:00.9).
Our Manchester member Chris Barber won from a very "classy" field in a fine 4:06.7 - a great start to the New Year, in which we hope Chris will make many successful visits to the South.

In his spare time, what there is left from Belgrave duties, business commitments (often abroad) and helping look after a young son, Richard of fourteen months, Gordon lists amongst his hobbies, gardening and Jazz - having been a very keen follower of Chris Barber and Humphrey Lyttleton.
